# EmptyTrash checks an optional URL listener in both completion branches

The sole emptyTrash argument is nsIUrlListener. Existing protocol tests and the accepted folder command pass null, so absence is a real caller state. The historical3972 patch guarded success/start notification but its new failure lambda directly dereferenced aListener. The fixed accepted ExchangeFolder failure lambda checks the listener and returns NS_OK when it is absent. Keep that later guard distinct from the historical exposure and from the separate legacy no-message callback gap. This is a source-supported nullable-callback finding, not a reproduced crash, a current unguarded dereference, or proof of any platform outcome.

Scope: mailnews/exchange/listeners.
